activity.notes: Margherita of Savoy became Queen Consort of Italy when her husband Umberto I acceded to the throne in 1878 and remained queen until his assassination in 1900. She played a prominent public, cultural, and dynastic role but was not a sovereign ruler, so ATLAS uses active_in rather than rules or governs.

sources.title: Margherita di Savoia, regina d'Italia — Treccani
sources.citation_text: Treccani states that Margherita became Queen of Italy in 1878 and became queen mother after Umberto I's death in 1900.
